text:
Aisha (partnerships): Acme flagged an anomalous drop in billed credits for EU region around 02:00-05:00 UTC yesterday. They provided sample event ids and a CSV.
WebhookBot: incident: webhook_error_rate: partner=acme region=eu spike=3.4x window=02:00-05:00UTC
Tom (eng-partnerships): I pulled delivery logs. We see a cluster of late retries (8-12m) and a handful of duplicate deliveries that our ingest de-dupe threw away because their event ids had microsecond-level clock skew.
Nina (billing): From billing side, missing events caused 0-hour buckets for customers. We need to ensure replays are tracked so customers don't get double-charged.
Diego (infra): Hypothesis: partner retries exceeded our ack_grace=300s which moves events into a "late" path that does not update hourly aggregates. Two routes: increase ack_grace or make late-path accept updates to hour buckets if event timestamp belongs to active billing window.
Aisha (partnerships): Quick decision call: what is the minimal blast radius fix?
Tom (eng-partnerships): Minimal: (A) increase ack_grace to 900s for select partners (non-global roll), (B) tag incoming late events with original_event_ts and route them through a bounded reconciliation worker that can update hourly aggregates idempotently.
Nina (billing): We also need a ledger flag on replayed events: billing_metadata.replay=true and replay_id=<uuid>. That way our billing pipeline excludes them from revenue math until we reconcile.
Diego (infra): I'll sketch the bounded reconciler config. It will accept late events up to 24h behind, limit reprocessing to 10k events/min per partner, and emit reconciliation_audit lines.
Aisha (partnerships): Can we run a targeted replay for affected customers first, not full partner replay? Acme prefers minimal and targeted.
Tom (eng-partnerships): Yes. We have event IDs: 9a7b1c, 9a7b1d, 9a7b2a (from Acme CSV). Plan: staged replay -> staging validation -> run reconcilers in dry-run -> production replay with replay_id.
WebhookBot: note: replay-service created dry_run_job id=dr-20260319-01 by tom
Diego (infra): Reconciler config snippet:
```
reconciler:
  partner: acme
  max_lag: 24h
  parallelism: 4
  rate_limit: 10000/min
  idempotency_key: event_id
  audit_stream: metrics.reconciler.acme.audit
```
Tom (eng-partnerships): I'll open PR to: - add per-partner ack_grace override - add replay metadata labels (replay_id, replay_initiator) - ensure dedupe uses normalized event_id (truncate microseconds)
Nina (billing): Billing checklist for replay: record replay_id in billing_events, hold invoices for snapshots covering replayed hours, notify customers via notice-of-adjustment if billing delta > $5.
Aisha (partnerships): Communications: I'll send Acme the minimally invasive plan and get approval for targeted replay. Also will include expected backfill window and contact for escalation.
Tom (eng-partnerships): Test commands for staging replay:
```bash
# push specific event ids to staging replay queue
curl -X POST https://staging.redwood.ai/internal/replay \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $STG_TOKEN' \
  -d '{"partner":"acme","events":["9a7b1c","9a7b1d","9a7b2a"],"dry_run":true}'
```
Diego (infra): Alert rule: if late_event_rate > 0.5% for a partner over 1h, create page to eng-oncall and scale late-path workers x2.
Nina (billing): Can we add a reconciliation report email to partners after backfill? e.g., summary: events replayed, hours affected, charges impacted.
Aisha (partnerships): Yes. We'll attach `reconciliation_report.csv` and the replay_id.
Tom (eng-partnerships): Owners & ETA:
- Tom: PR for ack_grace override + dedupe normalization + replay metadata (ETA: 6h)
- Diego: Deploy reconciler + alert rule (ETA: 12h)
- Nina: Billing hold + report template (ETA: EOD)
- Aisha: Partner sign-off and comms (ETA: 3h)
Diego (infra): I'll also add a small probe that measures partner clock skew by sampling event timestamps vs receive timestamps and emit clock_skew.p50/p95.
Aisha (partnerships): If all good, we'll run targeted replay after partner sign-off. Please post replay_id here when queued.
WebhookBot: action: dry_run_job dr-20260319-01 completed by tom at 1767040100, discrepancies_found=2
Tom (eng-partnerships): Dry run found two events whose timestamps were >1h older than declared window; flagged for manual review. I'll hold until Aisha confirms.
Aisha (partnerships): Got it. I'll escalate with Acme and ask for any off-cycle retries they ran. Will update channel within 2h. :mag_right:
